sources.name: Owls Insight
sources.why: The Owls licence covers one user, not a product others pay for.

sources.name: PrizePicks
sources.why: PrizePicks terms ban scraping.

sources.name: Sleeper
sources.why: Sleeper has no public lines API licence; its app API is used unofficially.

sources.name: Underdog
sources.why: Underdog terms ban scraping.

sources.name: VLR.gg
sources.why: VLR.gg terms ban scraping (vlrggapi is a scraper of it).

sources.name: bo3.gg
sources.why: bo3.gg has no public API licence; its site API is used unofficially.

sources.name: HLTV
sources.why: HLTV terms ban scraping.

sources.name: Games of Legends (gol.gg)
sources.why: gol.gg pages are scraped; no data licence.

sources.name: Pinnacle
sources.why: Pinnacle closed its public API on 2025-07-23; the guest API is unofficial.

sources.name: FanDuel
sources.why: Prices read from the page JSON its site uses: no licence for a paid product.

sources.name: BetRivers (Kambi)
sources.why: Prices read from the Kambi offering API its site uses: no licence for a paid product.

sources.name: Action Network
sources.why: DraftKings, BetMGM, Caesars, bet365, Fanatics, Hard Rock and theScore prices read from the JSON its odds pages use: no licence for a paid product.

sources.name: Matchbook
sources.why: Matchbook's public REST prices; its API terms cover account holders, not a redistributed feed.

sources.name: DraftKings Pick6
sources.why: Lines read from the loader data its site uses: no licence for a paid product.

sources.name: Bovada
sources.why: Prices read from the JSON its site uses; an offshore book, never a venue for US subscribers.

review.name: Gemini Predictions
review.note: Public prediction-markets REST (api.gemini.com, no key): check its API terms on redistribution before charging.

review.name: The Odds API
review.note: Paid plans allow use in apps; check the plan terms.

review.name: PandaScore
review.note: Free tier terms: check commercial use.

review.name: LoL Esports schedule
review.note: Unofficial use of the public key the lolesports site uses.

review.name: Oracle's Elixir
review.note: Free downloads; check terms and credit.

providers.name: LoL Esports schedule
providers.note: Unofficial use of the public key lolesports.com's own site uses; finished series and upcoming matches.

providers.name: Kalshi
providers.note: Match winner books (KXLOLGAME) via the esports board; the market price the model is judged against.

providers.name: Polymarket US
providers.note: LoL match winner markets (esports_match_winner) from the US exchange, with its taker fee; a second Texas venue next to Kalshi. POLYMARKET_US=off turns it off.

providers.name: Polymarket (global)
providers.note: Reference price only; not a venue for US users and never linked.

providers.name: Riot developer API
providers.note: Serves public ranked games, not pro match results; nothing here reads it. Set RIOT_API_KEY only if a ranked-play feature is built.

CS2.error: results not read yet (the ratings refresh runs at boot and every six hours)
